CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_product_event_v1(p_event_id uuid, p_event text, p_dimensions jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_event not in ('recommendation_impression','recommendation_open','page_opened','editorial_list_opened','book_card_opened','book_detail_opened','taste_result_opened','referral_arrival') then raise exception 'browser event required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return product_metrics.record_event(p_event_id,p_event,p_dimensions);
end$function$
